theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+7.20%) and Industrials (+2.95%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.33%) and Consumer Staples (-0.11%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +4.08% versus +0.82% for defensives and +1.18% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +6.35% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +2.93%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +3.38%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 25.83% to 26.62, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.75% to $3,634.80, crude oil was little changed at $79.63, and bitcoin slipped 1.22% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
